Page 11 carries the expungement-purpose STATE check, the photo-ID and in-person-or-mail acquisition, the $5 stated as a charge for the record and not a court filing fee, the refusal to substitute the fingerprint-based national employment check, and the sentence that a clear state report does not by itself prove that no relevant arrest or disposition exists; the provenance paragraph states THIS BUILD DID NOT FETCH riag.ri.gov. ROUTE_OPTIONS.evidence: Read at 300 dpi on the held bytes: page 1 of Superior-55 says Part Two is for a person 'convicted of a single FELONY offense', and the fourth box of Part Two on page 3 of the same form reads 'That I was convicted of a single MISDEMEANOR offense'. Both texts are on the form this reader hashed, so RI-B-06 is real and was confirmed here first-hand rather than relayed. A felony filer cannot truthfully mark the box the route requires, and no held source supplies corrected wording, an attachment or an acknowledged court handling. The packet's response is correct: it marks nothing, prints both texts as they are printed, tells the filer not to mark a box that is untrue, sends the question to the clerk or a lawyer, and says in terms 'WHAT WOULD SETTLE IT IS NOT IN THIS PACKET ... none is established by any source this build holds'. Every other election on the form is right: expunged marked, sealed blank, the second relief bullet marked, the Sec. 12-1-12 bullet blank, all judicial-complex boxes blank, every sworn box in every Part blank. This obligation is therefore not failed for a defect; it cannot be met on the sources held here.
ROUTE_OPTIONS.finding: RI-B-06 remains open and binds this family. The route's own required sworn election has no truthful text on the current official form, and the answer must come from an issuer correction by the Rhode Island Judiciary or a qualified legal determination. Nothing in this container can supply it.

historicalSelectedRow.disclosureRuling: RI-B-06 is DISCLOSED TRUTHFULLY and is not answered. The packet reproduces both conflicting official texts exactly as printed, marks no box, states that no corrected wording, attachment or court-approved handling is written here because none is established by any held source, names where an answer would have to come from (an issuer correction by the Rhode Island Judiciary, or a qualified legal determination), and says that nothing in the packet permits swearing to an untrue statement. No fee, no affidavit wording and no clerk's handling is invented anywhere in this packet. This family is therefore NOT failed for the disclosure. What remains unmet is the route's own sworn election, which is why the verdict is BLOCKED_LEGAL_INPUT and not PASS.
historicalSelectedRow.whatRemainsUnmetAndWhy: ROUTE_OPTIONS. A first-offender felony filer must swear a Part Two that, on the current official form, describes a single MISDEMEANOR conviction. Until the Rhode Island Judiciary corrects the form or a qualified legal determination supplies the handling, there is no truthful election for this route and no amount of packet work in this container can create one.
